episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.summary: The dead speak.Detective James Cormack is put on the trail of a murderer from a 1994 case that was never solved.

episodes.title: Ezekiel
episodes.summary: Something is rotten in the state of Ashford.

episodes.title: Running
episodes.summary: In 2003 Zoe Jacobs disappeared during her 21st birthday party. Many believe that Zoe ran away but others suspect she was murdered. When police officer Sam Kahlil discovers Zoe's blue backpack, Detective James Cormack is called in to investigate.

episodes.title: Hope
episodes.summary: New evidence gives Nadja and Sam hope that Zoe is still alive. But as Cormack puts together a timeline of Zoe's disappearance, the old theory that Zoe drove to Brisbane doesn't add up.

episodes.title: Ghost
episodes.summary: Cormack invites Sam to examine the contents of Zoe's backpack and probe her memory for clues. Re-examining CCTV footage from the night she disappeared, Cormack discovers Zoe actually drove to Xanadu, the rural property where Joseph was living.

episodes.title: Control
episodes.summary: The truth of what happened to Zoe sends shockwaves through the community.

episodes.title: Sapphire
episodes.summary: Cormack and Sam uncover what happened the night Zoe went missing. Cormack returns to Brisbane to throw himself into the search for Ritchie.
